description: Copilot CLI writes one process log per session to ~/.copilot/logs/process-<timestamp>-<pid>.log under the default home. copilot-home-relocation covers COPILOT_HOME.
note: Path-only characterization: Telltale registers only project-local logs/copilot. The pinned v1.0.101 changelog and configuration docs confirm the home path, not these Telltale synthetic fixture contents. Static inspection of the earlier official v1.0.96 Linux runtime archive (SHA256 e6c9513e7dcff38e424c247a8ae7b5b8a283e93973b77eb31fba9ef769f1c95b) documents default logging as info but does not establish the required Accumulated output items format. It does not qualify v1.0.101 either. Home discovery and supported promotion remain blocked on authoritative format/default-level evidence and successful discovery plus acquisition. No live capture was performed.
